content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"The denial is for missing required prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted, while resubmission or another appeal would not cure the authorization defect; billing the full balance to the patient could exceed contractual patient liability. No available automated action can properly progress the claim, so specialist review is warranted before write-off."}
